settings.hero_text: Simple information about receiving your order and what to do if something isn’t quite right.
settings.help_text: If you have a delivery or returns question, send us your order number and a short description of the issue.
settings.hl_heading: Free delivery on UK orders over £30.
settings.hl_text: Any delivery charge for smaller orders will be shown clearly before checkout.

settings.heading: UK delivery
settings.text: We deliver across the UK. Free delivery applies when your order total is over £30.

settings.heading: Dispatch & delivery times
settings.text: Estimated dispatch and delivery timings will be shown during checkout and in your order confirmation where available.

settings.heading: Tracking
settings.text: If tracking is available for your order, the details will be sent to the email address used at checkout.

settings.heading: Delivery problems
settings.text: If your parcel is delayed, missing or arrives damaged, contact us with your order number so we can look into it.

settings.heading: If you need to return something
Before returning an item
settings.text: Please contact us first with your order number and the reason for the return. We’ll confirm the next steps before anything is sent back.

settings.heading: Product condition
settings.text: Return eligibility may depend on the condition of the product and whether it has been opened or used. We’ll confirm this with you when you contact us.

settings.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
settings.text: If something arrives damaged or you receive the wrong item, let us know as soon as possible and include photos where helpful.

settings.heading: Refunds
settings.text: Where a refund is due, it will be returned to the original payment method after the return has been reviewed.
